review: numeric audit of approved original recordings; no policy or simulator calls
ranges: zero-based [start,stop), one source frame = one physical control action
threshold_caveat: Flags are viewing candidates, not rejection or expert-quality labels. Contact, intentional holds and recovery may be valid. Cached post-observation vs regenerated next pre-observation may differ; continuity residual alone is not proof of a missing action.
